We need to extract SMILES of unknown organic compound from sample. We have no data given. We need to perform measurements to deduce structure. Tools: mass spec, NMR, IR, etc. We need to be efficient, minimize experiments. Probably start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe get formula via isotopic distribution? But we can also directly get formula via get_formula_from_smiles if we have candidate. But we need to find SMILES.

We have no initial info. So we need to run mass_spectrometry_spectra to get m/z. Then maybe retrieve DBE formula, calculate formula? But we don't have direct formula extraction tool. Could use mass spec to get molecular ion peak. Then maybe use isotopic distribution to infer elements. Could also use NMR to get functional groups.

Given limited time, we can try to get mass spec first.
